name: Valley of Kings
summary: At Valley of Kings, stone rulers guard the southern road into the Searing Gorge. In southwestern Loch Modan, the canyon lies south of the passage to Dun Morogh. Blackrock forces and troggs threaten travelers beneath the dwarven monuments.

sections.title: Guardians of the Southern Pass
sections.body: Two immense statues watch over the southern pass: King Madoran Bronzebeard and High Thane Khardros Wildhammer. After the kings died, their sons commissioned the carvings together. The statues honor the allied victory in the War of the Three Hammers, and they face the Dark Iron clan. Beyond them, the southern lands still bear the ruin left by Ragnaros's summoning.

sections.title: The Gate to the Searing Gorge
sections.body: The valley links South Gate Pass with Stonesplinter Valley, and an iron gate opens into the Searing Gorge. Hostile Blackrock orcs, Dark Iron dwarves, and volcanic dangers make the passage perilous. So Ironforge mountaineers keep the gate locked and guarded, with Mountaineer Pebblebitty watching the threshold. Only the hardiest travelers may pass, after showing they have the strength to survive beyond it.

faq.q: Who do the two giant statues represent?
faq.answer: The statues depict King Madoran Bronzebeard of Ironforge and High Thane Khardros Wildhammer. Their sons commissioned them together after their fathers died, to honor the alliance that won the War of the Three Hammers.

faq.q: Why were the statues built facing south?
faq.answer: The statues face the southern lands ruined by the Dark Iron clan's summoning of Ragnaros. The twin kings watch over the approach to the northern dwarven lands and warn hostile forces away.

faq.q: How do I get through the locked gate at the southern end?
aliases: how to open searing gorge gate
faq.answer: The gate into the Searing Gorge stays locked for travelers' safety. Speak with Mountaineer Pebblebitty, who guards it, and prove your abilities by completing a task for her. Then she will give you the key.
The valley links South Gate Pass toward Dun Morogh, trogg-infested Stonesplinter Valley to the east, and the Searing Gorge through its guarded southern gate.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you walk hallowed ground honoring the bond between Bronzebeard and Wildhammer, forged against the Dark Irons' treachery.
As an ally, you pass through the northern bulwark against threats from the southern badlands. The dangers of the Searing Gorge threaten Khaz Modan.
